review.description: Install and connect a private workspace retains its existing scenarios and authority boundaries; shared domain/transport/build inputs now also carry independent PR-review observations. No existing contract is rewritten to imply publication or close live acceptance gaps.
review.implementation: Reviewed the additive receipt structs and read-only transport tool, metadata-only snapshot versions and after-turn background refresh. Existing launch, answer, cleanup, relationship, priority and credential paths retain their prior transitions; review retrieval makes GET requests only and honors pause and budget.
review.tests: Retain the existing mapped assertions for S1, S2, S3. Fresh common Go/browser/release suites cover shared inputs; new publication assertions establish only submitted receipt visibility, cadence and failure retention, and do not supply unrelated host/soak/login evidence.
